entries.canonical_text: The people behind the prize say they want to ask other literary prizes a question. Those prizes are trying to decide what to do about writers using AI. They create one prize and ask the others, So, what would you do? You could call it a question shaped like a trophy. Imagine you are reading a story late at night. The last line moves you. Then you hear, Actually, I wrote it with AI. Would a line that seemed beautiful suddenly feel far away? Or would you say, I enjoyed it, so I have no complaint? A special meeting to judge the story might start inside your mind. Of course, the label co-written with AI does not mean the story is interesting. I would not want to read it just because of that, either. I want to know what kind of story it is and how it is written. Before the label, I want to see the first page.
